children: Advait Energy Transitions share price will remain in focus on November 18 following the order win from Gujarat Energy Transmission Corporation (GETCO).

The company has secured an order worth Rs 130.48 crore from Gujarat Energy Transmission Corporation (GETCO) for the supply, installation, testing and commissioning of reconductoring work on the 220kV Dahej-Haldarwa Line-1 and Line-2 in Bharuch Circle.
The project involves replacing the existing ACSR Zebra conductor with a higher-ampacity conductor and is scheduled to be executed within 15 months.

Earlier this month, the company received two orders from Dakshin Gujarat Vij Company worth Rs 69.53 crore and Rs 62.05 crore, respectively, for converting existing 11/22 kV high-tension and low-tension overhead networks into underground cable networks under the SI Scheme (Robust 3).
These projects are to be completed within 24 months.

The company had reported a strong performance for the September quarter, with consolidated net profit rising 88.5% year-on-year to Rs 19.18 crore.
Revenue increased 40.8% to Rs 220.9 crore from Rs 156.9 crore, while EBITDA jumped 84.4% to Rs 31.9 crore from Rs 17.7 crore in the year-ago quarter.
In the previous trading session, the share closed at Rs 1,836.80, up Rs 4.80, or 0.26 percent.
The share touched a 52-week high of Rs 2,485.70 and a 52-week low of Rs 1,321.05 on 17 June, 2026 and 16 January, 2026, respectively.
Currently, the stock is trading 25.99 percent below its 52-week high and 39.26 percent above its 52-week low.
The market capitalisation of the company stands at Rs 2,017.36 crore.

title: Advait Energy shares in focus after securing Rs 130.5 crore GETCO order
